messages:
maria_finance: FYI — saw a weird line on ACME's capacity invoice (INV-2028-0042). there's a negative line for 'capacity adjustment' that doesn't match our reconciliation report. https://invoices.redwood.example/INV-2028-0042 :thinking_face:
ajay_sales: link works for me. which amount is off?
maria_finance: invoice total is $48,600 but our committed usage reconciliation sums to $51,000. at the bottom there's a -$2,400 'capacity adjustment' that we didn't authorize.
billing-bot: auto-match task: invoice INV-2028-0042 mapped to commit C-ACME-2028Q1. usage delta = -4.7059% (system detected manual credit line).
oliver_ops: possible causes: manual credit applied for a prior outage? or pro-rated commit proration. i don't see any recent SLA credit events for acme in the incident log.
maria_finance: checked incident history — only a brief failover on 2028-02-11 but SLA ping didn't trigger a credit per our rule set.
ajay_sales: acme rep says they received an email saying "adjustment applied for billing error" but can't forward it yet.
sylvia_cfo: tagging to keep me in loop. if this is an unauthorized manual credit we should pause payment until resolved.
maria_finance: agreed. i've put the invoice on hold in the AR system. request: can eng confirm whether any automated billing job created that negative line?
oliver_ops: digging now. quick snippet from bill generator logs around invoice generation:
```
2028-03-12T03:12:08Z BILLGEN INFO invoice=INV-2028-0042 commit=C-ACME-2028Q1 calc_total=51400 adjustments_applied=[{"code":"AUTO_PRORATE","amount":-2400}]
2028-03-12T03:12:09Z BILLGEN DEBUG matched_usage=51000 rounding_diff=-400
```

maria_finance: interesting — AUTO_PRORATE? that's not normally emitted for quarterly reserved commits.
oliver_ops: it's odd. AUTO_PRORATE gets triggered when we see overlapping commit windows during migration. did ACME move from one reserved pool to another mid-quarter?
ajay_sales: they did request a region migration to eu-west on Feb 9, asked for minimal downtime.
oliver_ops: that would explain prorate in principle, but the amount doesn't line up with our manual migration proration formula. looks like the generator applied proration twice in a specific code path.
billing-bot: incident-notify: potential billing generator logic bug flagged. severity: low-medium. ticket: BG-9342.
sylvia_cfo: what's the recommended remediation? reverse the adjustment and reissue invoice?
maria_finance: two options: 1) reverse the -$2,400 credit, reissue invoice and collect the $2,400 (may impact customer relationship), or 2) keep the adjustment and escalate to engineering for a permanent fix + memo to customer explaining cause. we should also consider an SLA goodwill credit if customer pushed back.
ajay_sales: acme prefers option 2 if we can give a clear explanation and a timeline for fix. they asked for a one-time goodwill waiver if they're asked to pay the extra.
oliver_ops: proposed fix: patch bill generator to dedupe proration events for migration window; hotfix deploy target EOD UTC. once merged, we can regenerate batch for affected invoices.
maria_finance: can we regenerate INV-2028-0042 after the hotfix and compare numbers? if the credit disappears we revert hold and bill for $51,000.
sylvia_cfo: approve engineering hotfix and regeneration. also pre-approve a temporary customer credit cap of $2,500 for this issue while root cause is finalized. finance, please document an approval memo for audit.
maria_finance: noted — i'll file memo and mark hold state. ajay, please notify acme that we're investigating and that a follow-up will arrive within 48h.
ajay_sales: pinged acme: "we're on it, expect update within 48 hours. sorry for the noise." :thumbsup:
maria_finance: created internal ticket FIN-5781 to track hold, memo, and potential collection steps. linking engineer ticket BG-9342.
oliver_ops: will push fix and post back with CI log. rough timeline: hotfix PR in 2 hours, deploy after 1h CI, regen invoices overnight.
billing-bot: regen-scheduler: queued job to regenerate invoices for accounts with BG-9342 tag. ETA 2028-03-13T06:00:00Z.
sylvia_cfo: good. once regeneration is done finance to reconcile and if discrepancy remains open we escalate for customer credit approval.
maria_finance: thanks — i'll keep this thread updated. if anyone sees other invoices with AUTO_PRORATE lines please drop them here.
ajay_sales: acme rep replied: "thanks, appreciate the proactive response."
maria_finance: last note: we will not issue any immediate SLA credits for ACME unless the regen confirms we underbilled them. sylvia pre-approved a goodwill cap but we'll only use it if the customer asks for waiver.
